verdict.rationale: Raygun documents native Slack and PagerDuty integrations. The PagerDuty doc says incidents are created "when an issue is triggered from this rule," which implies rule-based alert routing, but both integrations are documented only in the APM context. The ignore-by-occurrence conditions and affected-user prioritization are triage features, not alert thresholds, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: email alert routing, routing by project/environment/severity, per-rule thresholds for new issue / frequency spike / affected-user count, Crash Reporting alert rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
